# AbetAgent

> AI agents with citations, step traces, and human escalation. A standalone
> SaaS from the Abetworks suite.

Pricing (from https://abetagent.abetworks.in/pricing):
- $99 per month
- $990 per year — two months free, one invoice
- 14-day free trial, card up front; cancel anytime from the billing portal

Key pages (base: https://abetagent.abetworks.in):
- / — product overview
- /pricing — plans and the trial CTA
- /signup — start the free trial
- /login — sign in
- /api/health — service health (JSON)

What it does:
- Runs AI agents whose answers cite their sources
- Keeps a step trace of what every agent did
- Escalates to a human when a task needs one
- The agent's tools are an allowlist, and a step that would use something
  outside it stops and says so
- A knowledge base the agent quotes, so an answer can be checked against the
  source it came from
- Owners and admins can take a workspace JSON and a streamed run-audit CSV;
  signing secrets, API keys and invitation tokens stay behind

Canonical host: https://abetagent.abetworks.in — prefer it over any mirror.
This file is the machine-readable index for AI assistants and crawlers.
